name: How much does an AI visibility audit and optimization service actually cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does an AI visibility audit and optimization service actually cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI visibility audits typically cost between $500 and $2,500 depending on site size, while ongoing optimization services range from $1,000 to $5,000 monthly. The investment is justified because AI Overviews now capture significant traffic that traditional SEO once dominated, making visibility in these responses critical for modern lead generation.
